svg.title: CarCYD - ESP32 car dashboard and OBD-II display for the Cheap Yellow Display
svg.desc: Banner showing the ESP32-2432S028R Cheap Yellow Display running the firmware: gauge cluster, engine gauges, live OBD-II data and the fault code reader.

text.tspan: Gauges, live OBD-II data and fault codes
